sentence: This project builds solar and battery systems with smart controllers that can be controlled remotely and tries to detect cyber-attacks on them.
This project studies animal remains to find out what part early grassland cultures played in animal domestication and dispersal.
This project studies what computational resources reliable, data-driven decisions with physics-based models need, focusing on the design of renewable tidal energy farms.
This project modernizes a supply chain curriculum by adding advanced technologies such as Cloud Computing, robotics and the Internet of Things.
This project builds data acquisition electronics for a detector that searches for neutrinoless double-beta decay to find out whether neutrinos are their own antiparticles.
This project develops methods that use mass spectrometry to show where polymeric nanomaterials go in tissues and what they do there.
This project studies how technology can add to individual abilities so that individuals with disabilities can work in an apparel production line.
This project studies how mechanical forces and energy use work together to guide groups of cells as they move through three-dimensional environments.
This project uses mass spectrometry to study how the structure of peptides containing unusual amino acids relates to their gas-phase energetic properties.
This project uses a coastal sea anemone to study how variation in the copy number of immune genes affects its microbiome.
This project studies how structured matrices can help deep learning models do as well as large models at a fraction of the computational cost.
This project builds a software tool that adds molecular motion from computer simulations to AI models that predict how mutations affect proteins.
This project builds quantum sensors from electrically readable spin defects in hexagonal boron nitride to measure magnetic fields with finer spatial resolution.
This project runs lab tests and builds a machine-learning model to predict how forever chemicals stick to different kinds of materials.
This project works with industry and government to develop quantum computing, quantum sensing and quantum communications.
